policy: Third-party weekly API-equivalent values for subscription plans. Each value is a published third-party measurement, or a labelled projection. Figures are weekly dollars at the vendor's own API list price, converted to a 30-day cycle by 30/7. The headline value is used when a source gives one measured value with an account spread; the lower bound is used when a source gives an estimate range. The spread and the upper bound go in the tooltip and methodology.
